ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a curve graph of soil CO₂ concentration changing with soil depth under different vegetation. The horizontal axis is CO₂ concentration (ppm), with values increasing to the right; the vertical axis is soil depth (cm), with downward indicating the deepening of the soil layer. The legend shows that different symbols respectively represent natural grass slope, artificial grassland, cypress forest, cultivated land without vegetation, etc., among which artificial grassland corresponds to the black solid-circle curve. Observing the positions of the curves, the artificial grassland curve is overall the farthest to the right, indicating that its soil CO₂ concentration is the highest. Then reason: the question stem states that the higher the CO₂ concentration, the more significant the corrosion; and it assumes that moisture conditions are the same, so it is only necessary to compare the levels of soil CO₂ concentration under different vegetation. The CO₂ concentration under artificial grassland is the highest, so the soil and rocks under it are most easily corroded.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：这是不同植被下土壤 CO₂ 浓度随土壤深度变化的曲线图，横轴为 CO₂ 浓度，图例标明不同符号对应天然草坡、人工草地、柏树林、无植被耕地等。再推理：题干明确说明 CO₂ 浓度越高，溶蚀越显著，且水分条件相同，因此只需比较各植被曲线的 CO₂ 浓度高低。图中人工草地对应的黑色实心圆曲线最靠右、数值最高，所以其下土壤、岩石最易被溶蚀。答案为人工草地。
